source.manual_source_cards_section: MCNP 6.3.0 Theory & User Manual, section 5.8.2–5.8.3, pp. 393–394: SI defaults to H; SP defaults to D; the first histogram SP entry is zero and bin probabilities need not be normalized.

files.role: MCNP geometry, material, source, detector and tally input

normalisation.quantity: FNS measured angular leakage neutron flux per source neutron per unit lethargy at the center of the assembly rear surface, for each detector angle
normalisation.units: neutrons per source neutron per unit lethargy per steradian (as reduced by the detector-collimator effective area and solid angle)
normalisation.source_normalisation: per source neutron; MCNP SI1/SP1 vertical histogram distribution weights are normalized to their sum by source sampling
normalisation.location: five point detector locations from MCNP F5/F15/F25/F35/F45 input cards, joined only by their FC angle labels; missing supported locations are not synthesized
normalisation.energy_integration: MCNP E0 upper-edge bins; output is integrated per energy bin then divided by the lethargy width ln(E_hi/E_lo); coarse table ranges are preserved independently
normalisation.basis: JADE's pinned FNS-TOF raw-MCNP postprocessor applies the lethargy conversion to each point detector output and does not apply a second geometric multiplier. Its pinned by_lethargy implementation prepends 1e-10 MeV as the numerical lower edge for the initial bin and divides values by each adjacent ln(E_hi/E_lo). The pinned input deck FM card values numerically match the JADE definition L^2/A_s within 0.4% when L is computed from the SDEF target point to the F5 point and A_s=0.2304*L-84.16 cm^2; OpenMC applies the exact per-tally FM value from the input exactly once before dividing by the pinned JADE lethargy width. No additional L^2/A_s postfactor is applied. The JADE narrative sentence that says no FM card is present is retained as a documented source inconsistency, but the exact input card and JADE processing map determine this adapter's calculation path.
normalisation.JADE_docs_source_inconsistency: The narrative says no FM card was used; every pinned FNS-TOF deck contains per-detector FM cards. Those factors match L^2/A_s; JADE's actual raw postprocessor does not apply a second factor.

components.meaning: Fine tables publish an abs err column and it is checked against Value*Error (all 9,750 checked fine rows match); coarse tables publish only Error, so u is arithmetically derived as Value*Error. Source path, SHA256 and row number are retained in adapter.tables. Neither column's confidence level, systematic decomposition, or energy-bin covariance is specified.

uncertainty.note: Numerical reference uncertainties are retained without a confidence interpretation; covariance is unknown, so compatibility remains INCONCLUSIVE.

compatibility.k_basis: authored policy; comparison remains inconclusive while the source error/covariance meaning is unknown

covariance.basis: the experimental data do not publish cross-bin covariance or a complete measurement uncertainty model

neutron_leakage_spectrum.unit: neutrons per source neutron per unit lethargy per steradian
neutron_leakage_spectrum.description: Angular leakage spectrum values from the public FNS-TOF data tables; full source rows are retained, with under-range and straddling bins explicitly blocked.
